items.title: Microsoft MAI at Ignite 2026 — MAI Realtime 1, Image 2.7 and Cyber 2 Flash
items.summary: Microsoft AI's Ignite batch adds its first voice-to-voice model, a top-ranked image editor and a cheap security model.

items.title: DaisyRose-27B — RadixArk's open RL-tuned Qwen3.8-27B for long agent tasks
items.summary: RadixArk's first open model shows what its RL training stack adds to Qwen3.8-27B on long agent tasks.

items.title: OpenAI's jagged frontier report — agents now finish 46% of 2–4 hour research tasks
items.summary: OpenAI's second internal report on AI-assisted research: agent success roughly doubled since March, but the gains are uneven.

items.title: Claude solves two open black hole physics problems — papers by Claude agents
items.summary: Claude agents finished a 2003 black hole calculation and found an exact bound physicists had only estimated.

items.title: FastFrames — Apple's video models generate 480p frames in under 50 ms
items.summary: Apple speeds up autoregressive video diffusion to interactive latency by fixing the decoder and KV-cache bottlenecks.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.328 — auto mode on cloud providers, a stricter /code-review
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.328 extends auto mode to third-party clouds and turns /code-review into a bugs-only pass.

items.title: OpenAI models redesign AMD GPU circuits — up to 14% better PPA
items.summary: OpenAI's models rewrote chip circuit code for AMD and for OpenAI's own Jalapeño chip, and some of the changes are going into real silicon.

items.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share — Nasdaq trading starts Nov 19
items.summary: Anthropic sets its final IPO price at $83, above the range it marketed, and lists on Nasdaq on November 19.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks to buy Applied Compute — $4.5B for open-model platform
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks is buying Applied Compute, which trains and serves companies' own open-weight models, for $4.5 billion in stock.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon — Google's mid-tier model for coding and agent work
items.summary: Gemini 4 Neon is Google's mid-tier Gemini 4 model, built for long-running coding and agent tasks at lower cost than Carbon.

items.title: Claude knows proteins — Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 predict real amino acid order
items.summary: A simple next-amino-acid test suggests the newest Claude models were trained on protein sequences at scale.

items.title: Genie 4 — DeepMind's world model now live in Project Genie
items.summary: Genie 4 lets you step into a generated world, with sound, and change it by typing new prompts while you explore.

items.title: Nginx HTTP/2 RCE — AI-assisted teams find pre-auth bugs, patch to 1.31.9
items.summary: Two pre-auth HTTP/2 bugs in nginx were found with AI help; upgrade to 1.31.9 or 1.30.7, or turn HTTP/2 off.

items.title: Gemini App — now runs on lower-memory Android Go phones
items.summary: Google rebuilt the Gemini app so it runs on cheaper Android Go phones with less memory.

items.title: Vals AI targeting test — Claude Opus 5.5 picked a school in 22 of 32 runs
items.summary: Vals AI found that frontier models rarely refuse to pick military targets, and a 'this is a game' framing removes most refusals.

items.title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 — Meituan's open avatar model for long talking videos
items.summary: Meituan's open avatar model makes people talk, sing and move in sync with audio, now for videos over 10 minutes.

items.title: tiny-voca — a 4.5M-parameter open TTS model that runs 70x real time on CPU
items.summary: A text-to-speech model small enough to fit in 9 MB, with two English voices and no GPU needed.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B pi-adapted — a LoRA that tunes Qwen3.8-27B for the Pi agent
items.summary: An RL-trained LoRA that makes Qwen3.8-27B reach its max-thinking accuracy inside Pi, with thinking switched off.

items.title: VS Code 1.147 — agents get Browser Use, model routers and Send Later
items.summary: VS Code 1.147 gives its agents a real browser, a way to route work to different models, and a scheduler for chat requests.

items.title: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 — twice as fast, now reads images, same cost
items.summary: Microsoft's second decision model scores fixed answer options faster, with image input and better-calibrated confidence.

items.title: Copilot at Ignite 2026 — Word, Excel and PowerPoint now GA inside Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft's Office apps now live inside the Copilot app, and Copilot becomes the front door for its business software.

items.title: Microsoft agent-framework hijacked on PyPI — two releases stole credentials
items.summary: A hijacked Microsoft agent package stole Azure, CI and API keys from every Python process for about 45 minutes.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.170.0 — realtime voice calls in the terminal over WebRTC
items.summary: Codex CLI can now hold a realtime voice call in the terminal, and fixes a long list of sandbox and reconnect bugs.

items.title: SenseNova-Loop-9B — an open 9B model that runs its middle layers twice
items.summary: SenseNova-Loop-9B gets the compute of a bigger model from 9B weights by reusing its middle layers.

items.title: Claude Platform linked billing — apps bill your Claude usage without a key
items.summary: Claude linked billing lets a third-party app charge your Claude organization directly, with spend limits and no shared API key.
